text_block_list.text:
After a satisfactory victory in the G1
Hopeful
Stakes, Кинг Хало announces
her intention to
continue on to the
Triple Crown tour.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The tour can only be attempted once,
making the
competition fierce. She'll be
pressed to win three
races: the Satsuki
Sho, the Japanese Derby, and
the
Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And thus, Кинг Хало's next goal is the
first of the
Triple Crown, the Satsuki
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
